summary: B-7 SMOKE iteration 3 (frontend-only, LIVE preprod). Executed the 3 rows that iter 2 skipped: S-410 (walk-in via OLD RoomCheckInModal on r5), S-421/426 (Direct+CheckIn on r1 with POS room-service order), S-429/430 (2nd POS room-service order with add-on modifier). All 3 PASS with a few rupee-level rounding notes. Full cleanup done: Smoke 410 & Smoke 421 checked out with Cash (auto-HK moved r1 & r5 to HK). r2/r3 (other testers) never touched.

S-410.reason: Opened OLD RoomCheckInModal by clicking r5 tile (data-testid=table-card-8527) on /dashboard. Booking Type=Walk-in, Booking For=Personal (default), Guest 'Smoke 410' / 9999900410, Room Price ₹2000. GST block IS visible BEFORE confirming for a Personal booking (BUG-410 fix works): 'GST (ACCOMMODATION) 5% Slab · CGST (2.5%) ₹50.00 · SGST (2.5%) ₹50.00 · Total incl. GST ₹2,100.00'. After Confirm, folio /pms/folio/1232631 shows Room Price ₹2,000 + Lodging GST ₹100 → ROOM BALANCE ₹2,100 → Total Balance Due ₹2,100. Folio still lists a single 'Lodging GST' line (no SGST/CGST split — same BUG-418 as iter 2, not the S-410 concern).
S-410.figures: Modal: CGST 2.5% ₹50.00 · SGST 2.5% ₹50.00 · Total incl. GST ₹2,100.00 · Balance ₹2,100.00. Folio (order #000159, id 1232631): Room ₹2,000 + Lodging GST ₹100 → Room Balance ₹2,100 → Total Balance Due ₹2,100.

S-421/426.reason: Created Direct booking BID MG-69-3172FA9C-C8AD-4F94-82E7-70C3DCCB20D2 for 'Smoke 421' on r1 (₹2000), checked in via /pms/check-in?booking_id=<BID> (advance 0, Confirm Check-In) → order #000160 id 1232632. Opened POS Order Entry by clicking r1 tile on /dashboard (occupied room → order-entry route with badge 'r1' and guest 'Smoke 421' pre-bound → effectively a room-service order). Added menu item 'jeera rice' @ ₹107, clicked Update Order → KOT placed. In-House shows Smoke 421 balance ₹2,212.35. Folio /pms/folio/1232632 shows Room Orders section with 'Jeera Rice ×1 @ ₹107 = ₹107' and 'Room Orders Total: ₹112'. Balance breakdown = ROOM BALANCE ₹2,100 + ROOM ORDERS ₹112 → Total Balance Due ₹2,212. So In-House balance IS room base+GST + room-service subtotal INCLUDING GST (112 = 107 + ~5 GST). Only nit: In-House shows ₹2,212.35 while Folio Total Balance Due shows ₹2,212 (rounded) and POS cart preview showed ₹2,213 — three views disagree by ₹1 due to inconsistent rounding of ~₹0.35 across GST re-calcs. Overall PASS: the flow, semantics and inclusion of GST are all correct.
S-421/426.figures: Room base ₹2,000 · Lodging GST ₹100 · ROOM BALANCE ₹2,100. POS subtotal ₹107 · POS incl.GST preview ₹113. Folio Room Orders line ₹107 · Room Orders Total ₹112. In-House Balance ₹2,212.35. Folio Total Balance Due ₹2,212. POS Checkout button ₹2,213 (before place) / ₹2,212.35 (after place).

S-429/430.reason: On the same 'Smoke 421' stay, re-opened POS for r1 and added item 'nails' ₹13 with add-on 'with fingertips +₹15' (dialog Total showed ₹28 = item + add-on). Update Order → 2nd KOT placed. Folio /pms/folio/1232632 Room Orders now shows a NEW row 'Nails ×1 @ ₹13 = ₹28' (RATE column = base ₹13 but AMOUNT column = ₹28, i.e. the folio row correctly aggregates item + add-on). Tap-to-expand on that row reveals the GST breakdown: 'SGST (2.5%) ₹1 · CGST (2.5%) ₹1'. Combined GST = ₹2 = 5% of ₹28 (rounded up from ₹1.40). If GST were computed only on the base item ₹13, 5% would be ₹0.65 which would round to ₹0 — instead ₹2 is shown, confirming GST is computed on (item + add-on). Room Orders Total went from ₹112 → ₹142 (delta ₹30 = ₹28 + ₹2 GST) which matches the ₹30 delta seen in the POS cart total (₹2,212.35 → ₹2,242.35).
S-429/430.figures: Nails item ₹13 · Add-on 'with fingertips' ₹15 · Base incl. add-on ₹28 · Folio GST split SGST ₹1 + CGST ₹1 = ₹2 · Row Amount ₹28 (excl.) → effective ₹30 incl. GST · POS cart delta +₹30 · Folio Room Orders Total ₹142 (₹107 jeera + ₹5 GST + ₹28 nails + ₹2 GST) · Total Balance Due ₹2,242 · In-House balance updates consistent.

ui_bugs.issue: Same stay total is displayed as ₹2,212.35 (In-House) vs ₹2,212 (Folio Total Balance Due) vs ₹2,213 (POS Checkout pre-place). ₹0.65-₹1 divergence caused by inconsistent rounding of GST across 3 code paths. Preserve one canonical rounding (recommend round-half-up to nearest paisa in API, integer paisa in display).
Folio still shows a single 'Lodging GST ₹100' line without SGST/CGST split — BUG-418 for folio is still open (also flagged in iter 2). Modal correctly renders split, folio does not.
TAXES header present but empty (no SGST/CGST rows) — reproduced again on Smoke 410 checkout drawer. BUG-418 for drawer is still open.

GST on ₹28 (item ₹13 + add-on ₹15) is ₹1.40 but folio shows SGST ₹1 + CGST ₹1 = ₹2 (over-collects ₹0.60). Correct amount would be ₹1 total (halves ₹0.70 each). Consider rounding at the total-GST level rather than per-half.

action_items: BUG-418 (still open): render SGST + CGST split on GuestFolioPage Room Charges and inside PmsCheckoutDrawer TAXES block — currently only a single 'Lodging GST' line and an EMPTY TAXES section.
Rounding drift across POS/In-House/Folio (₹0.35–₹1 variance for the same stay) — pick one canonical rounding rule and apply to all 3 views.

Add-on GST is being displayed as ₹1 SGST + ₹1 CGST (=₹2) for a ₹28 base where the actual GST is ₹1.40 — over-collection by ₹0.60. Consider computing the total GST first and splitting into halves for display, instead of rounding each half up independently.
critical_code_review_comments: The folio row for an add-on item is stored well (RATE=₹13 base, AMOUNT=₹28 for item+addon) — this is the correct pattern for BUG-429/430; keep it.
In-House balance already includes room-service GST → BUG-421/426 fix is functionally correct in getInHouseGuests().
OLD RoomCheckInModal correctly renders the accommodation GST block for Personal (Individual) bookings, i.e. gstBlockVisible is not gated on Corporate — BUG-410 fix is in place.
Rounding centralization would eliminate the ~₹1 discrepancy across the 3 balance surfaces (POS cart, In-House, Folio).
